## 2010-11 Regular Season

**Minnesota Wild** scored the most goals against the Vancouver Canucks in the 2010-11 regular season. During Vancouver's championship-caliber campaign where they allowed only 180 goals (fewest in the NHL), the Wild emerged as the primary offensive threat against them.

The Canucks had several tough matchups that season, including multiple losses to division rivals like:
- Lost 5-3 vs Minnesota Wild
- Lost 7-2 @ Calgary Flames  
- Lost 4-3 @ Edmonton Oilers
- Lost 3-4 vs Anaheim Ducks
- Lost 4-1 & 1-4 vs Los Angeles Kings

Despite these blowouts, Vancouver still finished with an impressive 54-19-9 record and won the Jennings Trophy (fewest goals allowed in the league).

## 2014-15 Regular Season

**Calgary Flames** scored the most goals against the Vancouver Canucks in the 2014-15 regular season. This was a defensively vulnerable year for Vancouver, who surrendered 220 goals (19th in the league).

The Canucks went 48-29-5 that season and lost to Calgary in the first round of the playoffs. The team struggled defensively throughout the year, with their goals-for/against ratio (0.95) ranking eighth-worst in the league. Several teams were able to score heavily against them due to defensive inconsistencies.
